title: Rabbi Chelbo of Karuyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Midrash Tehillim (2:9 in the supplied text, 20:9 in Hyman’s printing), Rabbi Gamliel went to ask him to pray on his behalf. He said to him, “May He grant you according to your heart.” Hyman gives the reading Abba Chalfa bar Karuyah for the old Midrash Tehillim.

notes.text: Hyman supplies Midrash Tehillim 2:9, retained in the body. The OYW digital Midrash Tehillim 20 paragraph on “May He grant you according to your heart” contains the story and names Chalfa ben Keruya, differing from Hyman’s heading and bar Karuyah variant. Whether the supplied ב represents Hyman’s printed letter or another transmission of כ remains unverified.

A check of Hyman’s printed entry (vol. II, p. 452) resolves the spelling question in the preceding note. The locator is פ״כ־ט, 20:9. The supplied Hebrew still reads פ״ב־ט, 2:9. The consulted Midrash Tehillim chapter 20 names Chalfa ben Keruya and has Gamliel ask for his prayer. It also reports a different blessing in the name of Rabbi Huna bar Rav Yitzchak. Hyman’s Abba Chalfa bar Karuyah is the reading he attributes to the old Midrash Tehillim.
